title: I actually can explain it (The Mall). Iam one of the creators of it.
content: This feels so surreal that even a sub exists. I found out that this sub exists because of a post on r/astralprojection about it, where it got mentioned. (Astralprojection is a out of body experience) I will copy paste my answer: Quote „We all have been to the mall. The mall got created by „us“. By human consciousness. It’s a place that attracts you while you still are or have a human form. It’s very similar to the concept mentioned and shown in the movie „astral city“ Quote End. In the same manner as these places for recently dead humans got created by human consciousness we also created the mall by thought. You can enter it via out of body experience or via dream or lucid dream. You can interact with it, it can look different to every person relating to their expectation. To really understand where this place it, why it exists and how we created this via thought you need a basic understanding of out of body experience / astralprojection. All these places that are created by human consciousness attract you while you are in a different mind state like the dream state. For example we have also an own island, but this island is only for people who are still a living human consciousness doing a projection / leaving their body where a group of experienced astralprojectors meet. As humans, our inventions change through the years, so after the mall a new place for gathering human consciousness will be created and so on and so on. And so will the thought manifestation of the mall exist till no more people know what a mall is and we have a different place. I hope this helped and Iam actually super curious to now scroll through some old posts here cause this feels so crazy
